rows.text: The Prime Minister's Office release of 25 July 2022 quotes the Prime Minister that the nation watched as Smt. Droupadi Murmu took oath as the President of India, calls her assumption of office a watershed moment and refers to her address after taking oath.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-15 only.
